description: Historical OHLCV candles for a Hyperliquid market, aggregated from HL's own executed fills, by `view`. `candles` (default): one symbol's bars. Pass `symbol` as the HL asset (BTC, ETH, HYPE); `market` picks perps or HL spot and `dex` picks a builder-deployed HIP-3 perp DEX (default HL, the core venue). Buckets are left-aligned UTC and the window is half-open [start, end). Returns candles as {ts (epoch ms, UTC), open, high, low, close, volume, volume_usd, n_trades} ascending by ts, plus `source` naming the rollup that answered. `export`: the same, with `limit` defaulting to the maximum, 5000 (the REST export streams it as NDJSON). `latest`: the newest 1-minute bar of EVERY symbol that traded in the last hour in one call (takes only `market`, `dex` and `interval`; `dex` omitted = every DEX, each row naming its own; a bar may still be forming). Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/ohlcv, /ohlcv/export and /ohlcv/latest.

dex.description: Perp DEX. Default HL, the core venue; the others are builder-deployed HIP-3 DEXs. On `latest`, omitted = every DEX.

end.description: ISO-8601 UTC or epoch ms (exclusive). Default: now.

interval.description: Candle width. Default 1h; `latest` takes 1m only, its default.

limit.description: Max candles (default 500 on `candles`, 5000 on `export`; hard max 5000).

market.description: Perpetual or HL spot. Default perp.

start.description: ISO-8601 UTC or epoch ms (inclusive). Default: end - limit*interval.

symbol.description: HL asset: perp ticker (BTC), spot token (HYPE) or raw spot index (@107). Required by `candles` and `export`.

view.description: `candles` (default): one symbol's bars; `export`: the same with `limit` defaulting to 5000; `latest`: the newest 1-minute bar of every symbol.

name: hl_ohlcv
title: Hyperliquid OHLCV
